title: Pest-safe grain storage basics guide
context: Storage pests destroy stored grain; non-chemical and low-risk protective basics are well established but not collected in one open guide.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to low-risk, non-chemical basics for protecting stored grain from insects and rodents (hermetic bags, cleaning, inspection), summarizing established open guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers container hygiene, hermetic/airtight storage, inspection routines, and rodent exclusion
Explicitly avoids pesticide dosing or product recommendations
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
